Kit summary

Mighty BlowBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals DMG by 24% of Sun Wukong's Max HP to a single enemy. For every 1 layer of [Power of Dharma] owned by Sun Wukong, restores 20 Stance value for self. When [Power of Dharma] is stacked to a certain number of layers, grants extra effects: 4 layers: Each layer of [Power of Dharma] increases Mighty Blow's DMG by 10%. 8 layers: Removes all buffs from the target before Mighty Blow deals DMG. Afterward, consumes all layers of [Power of Dharma]. Not if the target is a boss.
Golden Cudgel Lv.1Each time an ally gains [Vajra Shield], grants Sun Wukong 1 layer of [Power of Dharma]. After Sun Wukong has 8 layers of [Power of Dharma], each layer of [Power of Dharma] gained later will be converted into 1 layer of [Monkey King's Hair]. After [Power of Dharma] is consumed, [Monkey King's Hair] will be converted into [Power of Dharma] immediately. Each time an ally launches basic attacks or skills proactively to an enemy, Sun Wukong will pursue and attack the main target for once if he has 4 or more layers of [Monkey King's Hair].
Vajra BodyActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [Vajra Shield] by 60% of Sun Wukong's Max HP for 2 turns. While Sun Wukong is under [Parry] status, if the duration of allies' [Vajra Shield] ends or allies' [Vajra Shield] is not broken after they take Direct DMG, Sun Wukong will remove their [Vajra Shield] and grant it again. However, the Shield value of [Vajra Shield] granted again will be reduced by 25%. The CD of Vajra Body cannot be affected or refreshed by other effects.
Golden Cudgel Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, casts Vajra Body for once immediately. If an ally has [Vajra Shield] at the beginning of their turn, cleanses 1 layer of a debuff from them.
Spirit RoamingPassiveExclusive Lv.3
Sun Wukong has an extra 30% Crit Rate. Also, when self Crit DMG is over 150%, 25% of the exceeding part will be converted into extra Effect RES, up to 50% extra Effect RES can be increased in this way. When an ally is marked as the main target of a basic attack or skill cast by an enemy, Sun Wukong gains 1 layer of [Power of Dharma]. If the percentage of Sun Wukong's Stance value is not lower than 70%/40% at the moment, there is a 100%/50% chance to make self as the main target instead. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Golden Cudgel Lv.3At the beginning of each wave and for every 8 layers of [Power of Dharma] obtained, Sun Wukong gains [Law of Existence] for 2 turns, during which increases all allies' Tenacity by 150% and Mastery RES (reducing DoT taken) by 150%. Also, increases the effects of [Law of Existence] gained the first 3 times each wave to 133% of the original.
Body Beyond the BodyActive
Grants all allies [HP Up II] and [Ripple II] for 2 turns respectively. Afterward, deals DMG by 19.5% of Sun Wukong's Max HP to all enemies and grants self 8 layers of [Power of Dharma].
